meta.title: DataRepublican's 990 money flows between organisations on the map
meta.notes: Grants between organisations, taken from DataRepublican's open IRS Form 990 data (github.com/twinforces/datarepublican). Each edge runs from the giver to the receiver and is credited to her in lead_origin. Single-year amounts come from her latest-year grants file (tax years 2022-2023); all-years amounts are the sums in her browse tool's $10M band, covering IRS e-file data 2017-2025. Where a return names a grantee without an EIN, her tool matches the name to an EIN; those parts are flagged in each edge's 'verified' note. Organisations with several legal entities are merged into one node (NDI and IRI; the three Tides entities; Open Society Institute, Open Society Action Fund and Alliance for Open Society International under OSF; ABA and its Fund for Justice and Education), and money moving inside one merged node is left out of the edges and noted in the node's role. Government-grant shares come from her charities file (each filer's latest return). DataRepublican herself is not a node. The 'audit' list checks each earlier link built from her site against her own data.
meta.credit: Data compiled by DataRepublican; map by ThatRetiredDude (CC BY 4.0)

nodes.label: Freedom House (Washington)
nodes.role: US democracy NGO, one of the eight groups in DataRepublican's 'NED Hydra' grouping. Its tax year 2024 Form 990: total receipts $69,617,662, of which government grants $64,078,135 (92%) (DataRepublican's 990 data).

nodes.label: American Bar Association (incl. ABA Fund for Justice and Education)
nodes.role: US lawyers' association; its overseas rule-of-law work gets NED, NDI, IFES and Freedom House money in DataRepublican's 990 data. ABA Fund for Justice and Education tax year 2024 Form 990: total receipts $109,268,636, of which government grants $84,564,330 (77%); ABA tax year 2024 Form 990: total receipts $266,358,504, of which government grants $0 (0%) (DataRepublican's 990 data).

nodes.label: Tides network (Tides Foundation, Tides Center, Tides Advocacy)
nodes.role: San Francisco fiscal-sponsor and grant network. DataRepublican lists Tides Foundation and Tides Center in her 'Soros' grouping. Money moving inside the network (all years in her data): Tides Foundation to Tides Advocacy $340,673,130; Tides Center to Tides Foundation $114,543,526; Tides Center to Tides Advocacy $105,411,838; Tides Foundation to Tides Center $91,868,330. Tides Center tax year 2024 Form 990: total receipts $282,975,548, of which government grants $37,810,397 (13%) (DataRepublican's 990 data).

nodes.label: New Venture Fund
nodes.role: Fiscal-sponsor fund, one of the funds Arabella Advisors has managed (Wikipedia). DataRepublican lists it in her 'Advocacy Networks' grouping. Its tax year 2024 Form 990: total receipts $664,320,202, of which government grants $11,000 (0%) (DataRepublican's 990 data).

nodes.label: Sixteen Thirty Fund (501(c)(4))
nodes.role: 501(c)(4) fund in the Arabella Advisors-managed group (Wikipedia). Its tax year 2024 Form 990: total receipts $284,289,469, of which government grants $0 (0%) (DataRepublican's 990 data).

nodes.label: Hopewell Fund
nodes.role: Fiscal-sponsor fund in the Arabella Advisors-managed group (Wikipedia). Its tax year 2024 Form 990: total receipts $230,588,028, of which government grants $0 (0%) (DataRepublican's 990 data).

nodes.label: Sandler Foundation
nodes.role: San Francisco family foundation; funds Democracy Forward, States United, GMF and the Tides and Arabella-managed funds in DataRepublican's 990 data.

nodes.label: Democracy Fund
nodes.role: Grant-maker that DataRepublican lists in her 'Omidyar' grouping. Its tax year 2024 Form 990: total receipts $63,960,855, of which government grants $0 (0%) (DataRepublican's 990 data).

nodes.label: Protect Democracy Project
nodes.role: US legal and advocacy group. Its tax year 2024 Form 990: total receipts $55,482,925, of which government grants $0 (0%) (DataRepublican's 990 data).

nodes.label: Democracy Forward Foundation
nodes.role: US litigation group. Its tax year 2024 Form 990: total receipts $67,735,822, of which government grants $0 (0%) (DataRepublican's 990 data).

nodes.label: States United Democracy Center
nodes.role: US election-law group co-founded by Norm Eisen in 2021 (Wikipedia). Its tax year 2024 Form 990: total receipts $35,194,579, of which government grants $0 (0%) (DataRepublican's 990 data).

nodes.label: RF Catalytic Capital
nodes.role: Rockefeller Foundation-linked fund; gives to the GGRF grantees Coalition for Green Capital and Climate United in DataRepublican's 990 data.
